description: Current bead-rs release binary built with the attempt-resolution feature enabled
git_commit_message: feat(pinned-binaries): pin HEAD attempt-resolution binary at f25ab5c

verification.method: sha256 computed twice after a forced relink (touch build.rs && cargo build --release --features attempt-resolution); both reads identical

notes: The '-dirty' marker comes from tracked .beads/* checkpoint files churned by the bead CLI's auto-flush in this shared checkout; compiled tracked source (src/, Cargo.toml, Cargo.lock, build.rs) is exactly HEAD (verified via 'git status --porcelain --untracked-files=no' on those paths).

sha256 is NOT reproducible across rebuilds: build.rs re-embeds BEAD_BUILD_TIMESTAMP whenever .git/HEAD or .git/index changes, so two rebuilds of identical source hash differently. Verify against the binary bytes present, not by rebuilding.

The attempt-resolution cargo feature is an empty marker feature; src/service/attempt.rs compiles unconditionally. Capability evidence is 'bead capabilities' advertising attempt_outcome and the 'bead resolve' subcommand, both confirmed on this binary.
